description.value:
A light- or vibroweapon you're wielding or carrying whirls into motion around you, circling your body in a 10-foot radius for the duration; your movement speed is halved while it spins with you.

Any creature entering the affected area for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 4d10 damage of the weapon's damage type, taking half as much on a success.

When the power ends, the weapon flies back into your hand.

Force Potency. Cast with a force slot of 5th level or higher, the radius expands to 15 feet, and the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.
